front: In AWS Lambda with an SQS event source, how do you retry only the failed messages of a batch?
back: Return a partial batch response with ReportBatchItemFailures.
extra: Lambda then makes the failed messages visible again, not the successful ones.

front: In AWS, a task must run one time, three days from now. Which service schedules it?
back: EventBridge Scheduler, with a one-time schedule.
extra: SQS delay queues and message timers reach [up to 15 minutes in the future](../facts/sqs.md#sqs-eventbridge-scheduler-for-advanced-scheduling).
